The Chinese characters for Caleb

As a transliteration, Caleb is usually written 凯莱布 (Kǎi lái bù). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

凯
Kǎi
triumphant, victorious
莱
lái
a herb (transliteration)
布
bù
cloth, spread

Origin and meaning

Caleb comes from Hebrew and means “whole-hearted, faithful”.

About the name Caleb

In the Bible, Caleb was one of the two spies who trusted God to give Israel the land.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Caleb carries the meaning “whole-hearted, faithful” and looks striking in brush strokes.
